title: knip ignore reasons
description: The written reason for every entry of the ignore lists in knip.json (ignore, ignoreBinaries, ignoreDependencies, ignoreFiles, ignoreMembers, ignoreUnresolved, ignoreWorkspaces, ignoreIssues), at the same key path: a top-level list under its own key, a workspace list under workspaces.<folder>.<key>. Each reason says what the entry covers and why knip cannot see it otherwise (at least 10 characters). Read by the quality-gates skill's check-gate-wiring.mjs (rule knip-ignores). Unknown keys are refused.

reasons.description: Ignore entry (exactly as written in knip.json) -> why it is there.

workspaces.description: Workspace folder (as keyed in knip.json workspaces) -> its lists.
